title: Temporal paired multi-family HGB replication on independent CSE-CIC-IDS2018 capture
selection: Coverage-only inspection before model scoring. Source, labels, cuts, quotas, verified row IDs, acceptance conditions and HGB arms fixed at release.
label_index_unit: Little-endian uint32 one-based CSV data row excluding header; index types disjoint.
cohorts: Canonical endpoint pair + IP protocol, designated 50/20/30 buckets by group. P/C/E strictly chronological. C is normal only; E sampled without class balancing from adjudicable records. Quarantine unresolved event flows and remaining native Infilteration.

models.hgb52_history: same 48 plus four strictly previous 60s measures

operating_point: Each arm independently registers ceil((n_normal+1)*.99) on C, score strictly greater; E is opened once.
comparison: On E, distinguish R19 gate (observed FPR <=1%, FP not higher, overall TP not lower, scanning TP and low-FPR partial AUC higher) from losses of non-scanning TP. Report each scanning evidence source, broad one-packet SYN, exact R19 signature, family, day, train-seen/unseen hosts, isolated CPU cost and stream replay.
scope: Retraining fixed learning recipes inside another capture. E other attacks are Bot, absent in P. E scanning has one source host. Exact47 E has zero scans and one nominal benign, so that particular R19 mechanism is not evaluable.
